exposure: Nulliparous women with normal glucose tolerance (NGT)
outcome: Protein expression of NLRP3, ASC, and caspase-1
cohort: Nulliparous women undergoing caesarean section (30 NGT, 27 GDM)
finding: Placental inflammation is significantly increased in women with GDM, potentially driven by elevated mitochondrial superoxide production by macrophages and mediated by the NLRP3 inflammasome.
